payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each query, count how many elements in the subsegment [l,r] are less than a[x]. If that count equals x-l, then the element at x would not move after sorting; output Yes, else No.
payload.rationale: The solution cleverly determines if a[x] remains in place after sorting a subsegment without actually sorting. It uses a linear scan to count smaller elements, which is a known technique in sorting-related problems. Among provided subtypes, sorting_custom_key is the closest, though not an exact fit as no custom key is used.
